english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the person is a wealthy tycoon who wields substantial influence or power.
Use this when the person's great wealth is more prominent than their business influence.

examples.english: That plutocrat's word carries a lot of weight in business.
examples.traditional: 嗰位富豪喺商界講一句都好有分量。
examples.jyutping: go2 wai6 fu3 hou4 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 gong2 jat1 geoi3 dou1 hou2 jau5 fan6 loeng6

examples.english: That tycoon donated a lot of money to charity.
examples.traditional: 嗰位富豪捐咗好多錢畀慈善機構。
